declaration.name: gate2-prediction-consensus-posthoc-v1
declaration.primary_rule: D_ij=mean over both horizons and all features of (native_prediction_i-native_prediction_j)^2; choose argmin_i sum_j D_ij
declaration.privileged_proxy_rule: Apply identical squared-distance medoid to each prediction's four archived joint future-prototype MSE coordinates
declaration.primary_selection_inputs: Only the three archived native prediction vectors; no targets, bits, roles, loss or metadata in the medoid function
declaration.proxy_selection_inputs: Four REAL future-target distance coordinates; privileged diagnostic, not deployable
declaration.tie_break: Exact float64 np.argmin, first candidate on exact ties
declaration.evaluation: same native joint-horizon losses and semantic mask as frozen Gate2; no per-horizon action mixing
declaration.attention_review_check: Report all exact-unique attention minima separately from singleton B uniquely below both duplicate cues
declaration.uniform_reference: One uniformly random deletion per family, shared by both styles and four siblings; semantic-loss probability1/3; independent reference n=24 families, not192 episodes
declaration.subgroups: all, each style, each duplicated physical axis, each style-by-axis; no subgroup filtering
declaration.forecast_actions: Archived predictions use actual recorded future planned controls; no deployed causal-policy implementation or action-plan intervention is tested
declaration.scope: Existing DEV only, no independent confirmation, no model changes
